title.rendered: CANCELED: Board of Directors Special Work Session – April 27, 2022

content.rendered:
Update (April 25, 2022): The April 27, 2022 Board of Directors Special Work Session had been canceled. Agenda topics will be addressed in future meetings of the Board. The next Regular Meeting of the Board will be held on May 11, 2022.

The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Special Work Session on Wednesday, April 27, 2022. For meeting agenda, please click here.

This meeting will begin at 5:30pm at the District Office Board Room. Members of the public are invited to attend in-person, or can view the meeting live stream on our YouTube Channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3
